cycles.kind: One independent published RCT Pickal 2026, 427 five-arm sample vs 345 motivation cases, 82 not in ANOVA. Unidentified full-arm contrast bounds conditional, not causal novelty.
Palikot 2026 randomized school bundled treatment; 4 vs 12 week original published aggregate activity/volume decomposition, no post-treatment causal mechanism claims.
Original Pickal OSF prereg/data/code linked in paper but web OSF inaccessible; no human rows or license/ethics attestation, cannot reanalyse exposures or missingness mechanism.

Regaco 2026 original Mendeley archive CC BY and analysis R code publicly catalogued. Matching-to-sample psychology does not establish PFL leaderboard randomization or eligibility/assignment; no human data accessed.
No distinct discriminating legal and ethical source with novelty beyond Pickal, Palikot, Felkey, Chen, Lumsden, GJP, and original forecasting evidence.
